title: What Batch Cooking Guide Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of batch cooking guide: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Batch cooking means preparing multiple meals in one session - usually 2-3 hours on a weekend - to cover a week of eating. It cuts weeknight cooking to reheating.

Why it matters: A 3-hour Sunday session can produce 10-14 servings Grains and proteins batch best; leafy salads do not

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Batch Cooking Guide
summary: Start batch cooking guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Pick 2 proteins, 2 grains, 3 vegetables
2. Write the grocery list from the recipes
3. Prep all vegetables first (mise en place)
4. Start the longest-cooking item (grains, roasts)
5. Cook proteins while grains simmer

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
